banner.title: MASTER FAMILY CHART AND ANCESTRY, printed capture pp. 64-65 - the OA ancestry round
banner.provenance: pinned from the 2018 print capture alone for this range (the settling authority): the first Mistral-OCR capture session is unavailable above p. 33, so the cross-capture agreement check is impossible. No contested cells detected within the single source: the T39 bands run contiguously 1 through 100 and every honor value sits on its printed row. The T39 result column pins as the 0-34 code (blank 0, roll again 1, criminal 2 through tragic event 34); the die bands pin as lo and hi bounds. OCR normalization: the T39 classic artist reads as the prose classical artist; the T39 roll-again rows 6, 10 and 20 read "next higher die or + 10" while row 97 reads "+ 10 on die roll" (the printed d100 doctrine - both pin as the roll-again code); Folk Hero capitalized as printed; the Assigning Ancestral Holdings and Birthrights prose (capture pp. 67-69) is deliberately left for the next rounds
banner.sentinel: the gap census after this round: 71 closed, 164 open - the Master Family Chart, Ancestry prose and Table 39 boxes flip (census 553 -> 554); NEXT - R632: the Assigning Ancestral Holdings prose, capture pp. 67-68, the head-of-family rule and the NPC-only holdings, prefix dgs (verify free), audit "R632 OA holdings audit", include after rules/oaanc.h
